searchText: I was thinking that the validator client would be receiving `head` events, and use the information from there. Hmm we are receiving those I guess. I’ll have a play and see how it works out. Otherwise you could actively fetch head with `/eth/v1/beacon/blocks/head` Yeah I’m still wrapping my head around this being so tightly restricted to just head. Everything else we have some tolerance for the validator being a bit ahead or behind.
